desc: Prove the exact parse-forest effect of reverse-and-flip on any balanced interval and establish the reachable local sibling transformations.
Exhaustively enumerate small cases to validate or refute the hypothesis that the orbit consists of all plane embeddings of the same unordered rooted forest.
Derive the product of local multinomial factors accounting for identical unordered subtree types.
Design deterministic bottom-up canonical IDs for unordered rooted subtree types and implement the \(O(N \log N)\)-ish counting algorithm.
Produce the final Python stdin/stdout solution and verify it against samples and edge cases.
